title: A Pawn Backs the Queen
setup: Your rook can seize the eighth rank, and a modest pawn on h5 quietly supports the square g6.
hint: Find the square beside the king that one of your pawns already defends, then take its back rank away.
explanation:
## The Idea

{{Rd8+}} takes the back rank and forces {{Kg7}}; the knight on c8 cannot block. Then {{Qg6#}}: the queen steps right beside the king, protected by the pawn on **h5**, while the rook seals every square on the eighth rank.
